hook: She was stuck on a sea cliff. The way off was a cable.
narration: She was stuck on a sheer sea cliff, and the only way off was a cable hanging from a helicopter.
This was near Crescent City, California. She had spent the whole night on that rock.
The Park Service called the Coast Guard, and a Humboldt Bay helicopter crew came in low.
A rescuer rode the cable down the rock face until he reached her.
A Dolphin's rotor is thirty-nine feet across, [short pause] and the pilot held it steady by the rocks.
He clipped her to the cable, and together they swung down past the boulders toward the surf.
outcome: The Humboldt Bay crew recovered her from that cliff.
title: Stuck on a sea cliff near Crescent City
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Humboldt Bay crew recovered a woman stranded overnight on a sea cliff near Crescent City, California, on May 13, 2015, after a request from the National Park Service.
